description.value: Pizza 64 is a Canadian pizza chain that has operated since 2010, with 20+ British Columbia locations making fresh dough and sauce on-site at each franchise. The Abbotsford location offers a broad menu of specialty, signature, and gourmet pizzas alongside wings, pasta, and sides. Takeout and delivery are available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Bourquin Crescent area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record confirms takeaway=yes and delivery=yes, corroborated by the website's prominent online ordering feature. The website menu reveals several plant-based/vegetarian pizza options (Garden Fresh, Pesto Veggie, Passion of India with paneer), supporting a vegetarian value=true. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities; the website content is chain-level marketing with no location-specific facility details.
concerns: OSM community field is set to 'Chilliwack' but the address (2785 Bourquin Crescent West, V2S 5X6) is in Abbotsford — possible community assignment error.
No phone number present in OSM or on the website for this specific location.
Website is chain-level only with no location-specific facility or contact details; all required cyclist criteria are unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate operating takeout pizza chain with cyclist-relevant food options, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. On-the-ground verification of facilities is needed before inclusion.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian pizzas: Garden Fresh (vegetables, no meat), Pesto Veggie (garlic, spinach, onions, green peppers, tomatoes), Passion of India and Shahi Paneer (tandoori paneer). No vegan or GF options confirmed
